brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
NAFCO builds GH¢100m food buffer as Ghana moves to strengthen food security. [1]
North East Gonja floods leave 246 homeless in Ghana. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR GHANA
The GH¢100m food buffer investment by NAFCO may help mitigate food supply disruptions, though Ghana's net energy import dependency of 0% suggests energy self-sufficiency does not shield it from climate-related shocks like the North East Gonja floods. [1][5][E3]

KEY RISKS
Ghana is linked to 3 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, which could complicate international trade and investment. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of the Kalshi market on whether the NDC wins the Ghana parliamentary election, priced at 61% on Sep 28, 2026, with a close date of Dec 7, 2029. [E4]
